entries.2419ea2df6d8b829: A manufacturer that handles the development, production, sales, and service of information and communication equipment, centered on cameras and systems for broadcasters.
entries.6a53505670a635a1: This business consists of the Medical Business, which handles medical cameras and medical monitors; the Security Business, which handles surveillance camera systems for the plant market and ＩＴＶ systems for conductors and drivers in the railway market; and the Inspection Equipment Business, which handles tablet inspection equipment and tablet printing equipment for the pharmaceutical market.
entries.a98a7b3591f3f698: This business provides studio cameras, vehicle-mounted cameras for relay vehicles, broadcast relay vehicle systems, broadcasting systems for the public sports betting market, helicopter transmission systems for government agencies, receiving base station equipment and other products. Overseas, it sells to broadcasters and production companies in North America, Europe and Asia.
